data.name: Casey Powell Lacrosse 18
data.detailed_description:
Casey Powell Lacrosse 18 offers sports fans a dynamic, fast, and challenging experience, with all the excitement, speed, and scoring of real-life lacrosse, including a completely reworked series of faceoff, shot, stick and dodging controls. It also features enhanced AI that responds to the complex 6v6 tactics of lacrosse. New motion capture animations for everything from faceoffs and shooting to post-goal celebrations add even further realism to the game.

New to Casey Powell Lacrosse 18 is the ability to create custom stadiums and logos for your team. On top of that, Lacrosse 18 features comprehensive player and team creators, allowing you to put yourself and your team right into the thick of the biggest competitions of all.

Anyone who has seen a game of lacrosse will know that it’s most notable for its unique faceoff battles, quick transitions between offense and defense, and the brutal stick checks players deliver to stop the offense. At the same time, the raw skill involved in manoeuvring the stick to take quality shots on goal makes for highlight reel action.
Casey Powell Lacrosse 18’s practice modes, manual substitutions, enhanced shot selection options, and improved stick and body check balance give lacrosse fans all the tools they need to play the game the way they’d play the sport.

reviews.review:
TL;DR: In short, as of release and the day after, this is an already decent game with explosive potential. Don't get it yet if you expect a perfect game with seamless fit and finish, though. (third edit addendum: Did Not Return, Practice Mode Added)

Will most likely return this game, $50 for a buggy mess like this is just not worth it. if anything, look to buy it after a few months or so, after they steamroll the bugs out of it (they'll need a steamroller, cause there are a lot of them). Dodges only work half the time, body checks literally don't do anything, players lag through checks and other players, computer players can do things your players can't (like lay out the ball carrier, and stand within 5 yards of the ball carrier on a restart), there's no penalty clock anywhere on the screen, and, perhaps most frustratingly of all, there is no practice mode to get used to the wonky controls. it's game or nothing. (EDIT: it even says it has a practice mode in the game description on the store page, there literally IS NO PRACTICE MODE.) so if you want to spend $50 on a game that looks decent and you can run, pass, catch, and shoot and that's about it, then look no further. personally, i would only spend $50 on this game if it was perfect. as it stands, it seems like they built the came for console and yet again tried to satisfy PC players with another shitty port. so like i said, if all that sounds good to you, then go ahead and knock yourself out; i'm most likely going to return it with the hope i'll have the money to buy it back later while riding on the even bigger hope that they will have fixed it up by then.

SECOND EDIT: After thinking a lot about it last night, I decided I won't return it, and I'll explain why I came to this decision as well as why I'm leaving it as unrecommended (for now...). So after playing a couple more games and becoming more accustomed to how the AI operates and catching on to a couple of the nuances in the game (I figured out my dodges weren't working because you either can't dodge or dodge very slowly when your player's SPRINT stamina bar is empty), I realized that a lot of the bugs I mentioned are fairly minor, and shouldn't take much time to correct. Even alongside the frustration of my first few games, I was still getting excited and having a lot of fun when I managed to score - it's immensely satisfying, simply put. So in my revised opinion, the lack of a practice mode is the biggest flaw in the game. Once they put that in (hopefully they do), it will pretty much be the game they advertised, at which point I will ammend my recommendation. Until then, I'm leaving it as unrecommended because of the game-altering bugs still present, and, as stated, the lack of a practice mode.


THIRD EDIT: practice mode update!! very excited to give this a try tomorrow, will likely spend at least a couple hours in it. Major issue down, now just bugs to go. i also aim to start cataloging the biggest ones so i can do my part and properly report them. Also, moved TL;DR to top.
P.S. I wish there was a way i could neither recommend nor not recommend the game until the bugs are worked out, but I did say i would change it once the practice mode was added. hopefully the TL;DR will sufficiently convey my thoughts.
P.P.S. Thanks HBK!
reviews.developer_response:
Hi Mentok,

We have just released an update that adds practice mode.

Within this mode there are two practice options. 3 on G (you and 2 teammates vs goalie) and 4 on 4 (you and 3 teammates vs 3 opponents and a goalie).

We're glad you're enjoying the gameplay and hope that this practice mode helps turn this review around!

Cheers,
HBK619.
